T2a - Runtime undo history
|-- Core / domain model / fine
|-- Scope: HistoryManager; excludes storage and reload

|-- Editor.history: HistoryManager
|   |-- store reference
|   |   `-- addHistoryInterceptor(): receives record diffs
|   |-- Recorder state
|   |   |-- Recording
|   |   |-- RecordingPreserveRedoStack
|   |   `-- Paused
|   |-- pendingDiff: changes since the latest flush
|   |   `-- Squashes repeated changes into one RecordsDiff
|   |-- undo stack / redo stack
|   |   |-- diff entry: record changes
|   |   `-- stop entry: mark id
|   `-- Replay state
|       |-- _isReplaying
|       `-- Pauses recording while applying a replay diff

|-- RecordsDiff
|   |-- added: id -> new record
|   |-- updated: id -> [before, after]
|   `-- removed: id -> removed record

|-- History boundaries and operations
|   |-- markHistoryStoppingPoint() -> history._mark()
|   |-- run(): synchronous batch + recorder policy
|   |-- undo() / redo(): replay to the next stop
|   `-- bailToMark(): cancel without creating redo history

`-- Lifetime boundary
    |-- HistoryManager owns runtime stacks and pendingDiff
    `-- TLEditorSnapshot contains document + session state
        `-- Native undo / redo stacks are not included
